note: Tracking (Dave 2026-10-21): trampled grass trails are part of tracking. Everyone's trails last base_minutes real minutes; a good Tracking skill makes them stay down longer on that player's own client only (the server does not change). Multiplier by Tracking skill: linear from 1.0 at skill 1 to at_100 at skill 100, through the table points below. Client reads InventoryView.trail_multiplier() (uses the effective level).

species_reading.note: Proposed, not built: Tracking 40 tells a track's species group (hoofed or clawed), 65 names the species, 90 also tells age and whether it was hurt.
